sources.title: Kimi Code What's New — K2.8 Preview, September 11, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated Model Release entry announces full rollout of K2.8 Preview through the unchanged kimi-for-coding ID, coding/agent improvements, adjustable low/high/max thinking, a no-thinking mode, and up to 1M context.

sources.title: Kimi Code Model Configuration
sources.evidence: Current six-ID table maps kimi-for-coding specifically to K2.8 Preview: 1048576 context, image/video input, and low/high/max reasoning (default max). K3, K3.1 Pro and K2.7 Code Highspeed occupy distinct columns. Documents native Responses/Chat Completions/Anthropic protocols and thinking-off routing.

sources.title: Kimi Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Sections 4.6 and 5 retain Moonshot AI service rights and restrict reverse engineering of service models and unauthorized copying or sublicensing; support a proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Moonshot AI official Hugging Face model inventory
sources.evidence: Direct API inventory returned 19 official repositories including Kimi-K3 and Kimi-K2.7-Code, but no K2.8 Preview checkpoint or model card.

sources.title: Kimi-K3 official model card
sources.evidence: Card discloses K3-specific MoE, KDA and Attention Residuals specifications. Full README contains no K2.8 mention or mapping authorizing transfer of those specifications.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.7-Code official model card
sources.evidence: Card specifies 1T total / 32B activated MoE parameters for K2.7 Code and maps its architecture to K2.5/K2.6. Full README has no K2.8 mention; these are not K2.8 disclosures.

sources.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
sources.evidence: Later first-party technical blog explicitly maps K3.1 Pro to post-training of K3. Its text contains no K2.8 Preview specification, comparison column or underlying-checkpoint mapping.

sources.title: Kimi Code Built-in Tools
sources.evidence: Documents agent-selected tool calls for file reading/editing, shell execution and web access; multimodal tools send images/video to models with matching input capabilities.

sources.title: Kimi Code SDK model provider
sources.evidence: Official SDK provider defaults to the kimi-for-coding model ID, connecting the documented K2.8 route with the Kimi provider implementation.

sources.title: Kimi provider request/response adapter
sources.evidence: Official provider accepts tool schemas, sends tool calls, and parses function tool_calls in regular and streaming model responses; handles textual message content.

name.note: K2.8 Preview is the official version name; Kimi is the product/model brand.

developer.note: First-party release documentation and service ownership identify Moonshot AI.

family.note: Normalized catalog family follows the official K2.8 name; this naming classification does not establish shared K2 checkpoint specifications.

release_date.note: Explicit dated public full-rollout entry. Targeted earlier-date/beta searches in English and Chinese and the preceding changelog entries found no earlier primary K2.8 release date; retain this earliest verified date, without claiming it excludes an earlier limited test.

open_weights.note: The documented release is hosted access; the official 19-model repository inventory has no K2.8 checkpoint. No separate weight release was located as of this review.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted release under restrictive service terms. No K2.8 open-weight license is established; sibling or client-code licenses do not apply.

parameters_b.note: No K2.8 total is disclosed in the inspected release, current comparison table, later technical blog or sibling cards. Do not transfer K3 or K2.7 Code totals.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact K2.8 active count or checkpoint mapping was found. K2.7 Code's 32B figure is explicitly for a different model.

architecture.note: Inspected primary material gives no K2.8 architecture. Targeted technical-report, training and interpretability searches found no exact-model disclosure; K2 naming and alias replacement cannot establish MoE, MLA, KDA or Transformer structure.

context_window.note: Exact maximum in the K2.8 Preview column, measured in tokens.

modalities.note: Model table explicitly lists image/video input; the mapped provider implements text messages and textual responses. No audio or generated-media output claim is made.

reasoning.note: Explicit low/high/max thinking levels, default max. Optional no-thinking service does not make this a non-reasoning model.

tool_call.note: Exact model route is supported by the official coding-agent provider, which accepts tool schemas and emits/parses function tool calls; first-party agent documentation explains execution.

description.value: Moonshot AI's Kimi Code preview model for coding and agent tasks, served as kimi-for-coding with adjustable reasoning, image/video input and a 1,048,576-token context window.
description.note: Uses documented serving identity and capabilities; removes an unqualified comparative efficiency assertion.

patch.description: Moonshot AI's Kimi Code preview model for coding and agent tasks, served as kimi-for-coding with adjustable reasoning, image/video input and a 1,048,576-token context window.
patch.notes: K2.8 Preview is the Kimi Code model behind kimi-for-coding. September 11, 2026 is the explicit full-rollout date and earliest verified release date in this audit. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed; K3 and K2.7 Code specifications and weight licenses must not be transferred. Reasoning is optional and adjustable. No K2.8 weights were present in the official repository inventory at review time.

summary: Confirmed all documented K2.8 serving capabilities and the September 11 full-rollout date; set descriptive proprietary licensing, replace comparative marketing description with concrete capabilities, and promote first-party provenance. Parameters and architecture remain null after exact-model searches, the current six-model comparison table, sibling model cards and the later K3.1 Pro technical blog. No earlier primary beta date or separate K2.8 weight release was located.
